record.interface_detail: Automation Cloud driven by Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer and Appium, Espresso and XCUITest against real iOS and Android devices; a Lambda Tunnel reaches locally hosted apps; REST APIs and SDKs for pipelines.
record.tooling: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer, Appium, Espresso and XCUITest suites via hosted grids; REST APIs including a Screenshot API; CI integrations with GitHub, GitLab and CircleCI; Lambda Tunnel for private apps; no shell-level device access or rclone backend.
record.chaining: A hosted real-device cloud for running mobile and web test suites in CI without owning handsets; the 100 lifetime minutes size a first suite, and at scale the Real Device Plus Automation Cloud tier is USD 199 a month billed annually for one parallel device, billed by concurrency rather than by minutes.

record.notes: A hosted real-device cloud for web and mobile app automation: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer and Appium, Espresso and XCUITest tests run on physical iOS and Android devices. The free plan gives 100 lifetime minutes with 2 parallel sessions; the paid Real Device Plus Automation Cloud tier is USD 199 a month billed annually for one parallel real device, which the operator's list converts to USD 0.273/h over 730 hours. No general-purpose shell VM is offered; the compute is a managed device session. Formerly branded LambdaTest; the company states it rebranded to TestMu AI on 2026-01-12.
